verdict.rationale: Kick provides its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server and a CLI. Through them, AI clients can query transactions, generate reports, create rules and execute bookkeeping changes, and custom tools get connection details for 'full access to read and update your Kick data'. Nothing documents that these surfaces match everything the UI can do, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public REST API with OpenAPI spec, an explicit statement or coverage map of UI/API parity (e.g. invoicing, reconciliation, locks, multi-entity splits, chart-of-accounts edits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
